about: Gulf Coast Law works from Executive Drive in North Naples and its Google listing averages a flat five stars across 54 reviews.

It publishes a privacy policy and none of the other trust pages pillar D looks for, no fee terms we could record, and none of the stages of a transaction, and it names no attorney on the pages we could reach.

G1.evidence: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Florida does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile; Secretary of State registration still to confirm

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 54 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2024-08-06, so it has been operating for more than a year
